items.reason: AdminPermissionManagement.VIEW_SCOPE and AdminPermissionsSchema.VIEW both equal "view" (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/AdminPermissionManagement.java:29; server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java:59). ClientPermissionsV2.java:82 explicitly checks that scope for the client, and :214 resolves the client-specific resource, contradicting the claimed absence of a per-client check.

The test uses a controlled realm fixture that creates myclient without overriding default scopes (tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/authz/fgap/RealmAdminPermissionsConfig.java:35), while services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/OIDCLoginProtocolFactory.java:292 registers multiple default scopes. The insufficient-scopes scenario is unsupported by this fixture; moreover, the initial unauthorized getDefaultClientScopes() fails at services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/ClientResource.java:382 before indexing occurs.
